entries.text: Added `Conjugate`, a matrix expression representing the elementwise complex conjugate of a matrix expression, so `conjugate(A)` and `A.conjugate()` for a `MatrixSymbol` `A` now give `Conjugate(A)`, which is printed as an overlined `A` in LaTeX and pretty printing. It is consistent with `Transpose` and `Adjoint`, for example `Conjugate(A).adjoint()` gives `A.T`, and it fixes an `AttributeError` for the adjoint of unevaluated matrix powers such as `(C**-2).adjoint()`.
